expected.name: Malformed record
expected.summary: Report record ordinal plus line and byte offset where available.
expected.override_policy: Nonterminal malformed records block automated repair; cannot be overridden to deterministic.

expected.name: Torn terminal record
expected.summary: Distinguish an incomplete final append from malformed data followed by later records.
expected.override_policy: Only terminal incomplete records qualify; repairable by conservative suffix drop.

expected.name: Duplicate event ID
expected.summary: Distinguish byte-identical duplicates from conflicting duplicates.
expected.override_policy: Defaults to warning/deterministic for byte-identical duplicates; detectors must override to error/manual when duplicates have conflicting contents.

expected.name: Missing parent
expected.summary: Identify the missing reference and affected descendants.
expected.override_policy: Repair requires proven unique predecessor; manual when ambiguous.

expected.name: Parent cycle
expected.summary: Emit a deterministic cycle path.
expected.override_policy: Cycles break causal DAG ordering completely; fatal and unsupported by default.

expected.name: Disconnected branch
expected.summary: Report unreachable components without assuming they should be merged.
expected.override_policy: Unreachable components may be intentional subtrees; manual review required.

expected.name: Ambiguous session head
expected.summary: Report multiple plausible terminal heads.
expected.override_policy: Multiple terminal leaf events require operator choice of replay branch.

expected.name: Non-monotonic timestamp
expected.summary: Child event timestamp precedes its resolved parent's timestamp.
expected.override_policy: Clock skew and vendor timestamp semantics are legitimate; reordering or rewriting timestamps is never auto-justified.

expected.name: Persisted secret material
expected.summary: Persisted record bytes contain a known secret token shape.
expected.override_policy: Detection reports family label, coordinates, and a match digest only; the matched value is never emitted and records are never rewritten.

expected.name: Interleaved writer markers
expected.summary: Writer identity markers (e.g. application versions) reappear interleaved in one stream — evidence of concurrent writers.
expected.override_policy: Forensic context only; marker sequences are never rewritten and a clean ordered transition is a legitimate mid-session upgrade.

expected.name: Record size anomaly
expected.summary: Largest record is an extreme byte-size outlier in the file's own distribution.
expected.override_policy: Informational tripwire only; records are never dropped, truncated, or rewritten on size evidence alone.

expected.name: Orphan tool result
expected.summary: Result references no call in the permitted branch and replay window.
expected.override_policy: Orphan result may be the only evidence of completed external action; conservative repair refuses.

expected.name: Dangling tool call
expected.summary: Required result is absent before the next disallowed boundary.
expected.override_policy: Dangling tool call execution state unknown; conservative repair refuses synthesis.

expected.name: Reused tool-call ID
expected.summary: Same ID maps to non-equivalent calls.
expected.override_policy: Conflicting tool call IDs cannot be disambiguated safely without operator intervention.

expected.name: Multiple tool results
expected.summary: More than one result maps to one call.
expected.override_policy: May indicate duplicate responses or race conditions; manual review required.

expected.name: Tool result precedes call
expected.summary: Ordering is structurally impossible under the selected profile.
expected.override_policy: Causality inversion; reordering requires profile-specific replay analysis.

expected.name: Cross-branch tool pairing
expected.summary: Call and result belong to incompatible interaction or agent scopes.
expected.override_policy: Interleaved agent scopes cannot be safely unified without trace knowledge.

expected.name: Provider adjacency violation
expected.summary: Pair exists but does not satisfy the selected provider’s placement rule.
expected.override_policy: Adjacency warning depending on selected provider/runtime profile requirements.

expected.name: Compaction split pair
expected.summary: A retained compaction boundary separates a required atomic pair.
expected.override_policy: May be repairable by compaction reunion recipe if both records are present.

expected.name: Checkpoint/history divergence
expected.summary: Serialized continuation state and durable records disagree.
expected.override_policy: Continuation divergence invalidates subsequent replay state.

expected.name: Accepted terminal output not durable
expected.summary: Runtime state indicates accepted output that the history cannot recover.
expected.override_policy: Missing accepted terminal output risks re-entering model or duplicate actions.

expected.name: Unknown side-effect state
expected.summary: Repair would require assuming whether execution occurred.
expected.override_policy: Conservative policy hard stop: automated repair must abstain when side effects are unknown.

expected.name: Token usage arithmetic inconsistency
expected.summary: Cumulative token-usage marker contradicts the window's usage sum.
expected.override_policy: Accounting evidence only; usage counters are never auto-edited.

expected.name: Compaction coverage gap
expected.summary: Boundary claims a covered span that is missing or non-contiguous.
expected.override_policy: Coverage claims are advisory evidence; the boundary record is never rewritten and the gap is never auto-filled.

expected.name: Durable-prefix boundary violation
expected.summary: Durable record sequence does not cover the envelope ordinal the resume path expects — trailing non-durable tail, durable hole, or resume-required field absent.
expected.override_policy: Resume-boundary evidence is advisory; records are never reordered, dropped, or field-filled to force a durable prefix.

expected.name: Context-pressure projection
expected.summary: Last declared context occupancy leaves too little headroom against the declared model window — approaching the un-compactable deadlock boundary.
expected.override_policy: Pressure evidence is advisory; usage markers and window declarations are never edited, and no content is truncated or dropped to buy headroom.

expected.name: Compaction snapshot divergence
expected.summary: The embedded pre-compaction snapshot disagrees with the durable item stream on a shared item's type, correlation, or ordering.
expected.override_policy: Snapshot evidence is advisory; embedded snapshots and stream items are never rewritten to force agreement.

expected.name: Unsupported format version
expected.summary: Adapter recognizes the family but not the version safely enough to repair.
expected.override_policy: Never silently guess or fall back to an approximate schema version.

expected.name: Unknown critical record
expected.summary: Unrecognized record participates in identity, parentage, pairing, or continuation.
expected.override_policy: Unknown records participating in core semantics block automated repair.

expected.name: Duplicate JSON key
expected.summary: Record contains a duplicated object key; parsers disagree on which value wins.
expected.override_policy: Conservative policy MUST refuse: choosing a winner silently invents data; deduplication is a human decision.

expected.name: Mid-file schema drift
expected.summary: Record-level schema version or format signature changes mid-file.
expected.override_policy: Drift may indicate a spliced file; records are never migrated or normalized across a drift boundary automatically.

expected.name: Provider-incompatible record shape
expected.summary: Record shape sits outside the replay vocabulary of the declared record family — file parses, replay target rejects.
expected.override_policy: Foreign-shape records are never rewritten to match the replay vocabulary; the known-shapes list is citation-only and never treats unknown shapes as foreign.

expected.name: Unknown non-linking metadata
expected.summary: Unrecognized metadata has no known identity, linkage, or replay-content fields.
expected.override_policy: Advisory only; metadata is never rewritten or discarded by a repair recipe.

expected.name: Unresolved cross-file link
expected.summary: Session references a file or head that is missing, ambiguous, or out of scope.
expected.override_policy: Link targets are never fabricated or guessed; unresolved references are reported, not repaired.

expected.name: Session index divergence
expected.summary: On-disk session files and the vendor session index disagree (missing membership, dangling entries, or an unparseable index).
expected.override_policy: Indexes are never written, rebuilt, or deleted by SessLint; divergence is reported as evidence for the vendor's rebuild path.

expected.name: Unknown side-effect state
expected.summary: Repair would require assuming whether execution occurred.
expected.override_policy: Conservative policy hard stop: automated repair must abstain when side effects are unknown.
